text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government publishes White Paper on casino gambling, proposing partial liberalisation to allow casinos to open in two or three five-star hotels. There is currently only one casino.
- Agriculture Minister Noel Farrugia visits Libya for talks on strengthening cooperation in agriculture and fisheries.
- Two men jailed for six years and fined 5,000 Maltese pounds (about $13,000) for drug trafficking.

- Normality returns to Malta Drydocks after stopwork on Friday. Council chairman Noel Zarb Adami tells dockyard workers he regretted comments he made to relatives of nine workers, killed in a dockyard explosion two years ago, after the two sides could not agree on compensation. Agreement has since been reached.
